Name: Linda
Dialog: Morning, sunshine! So, what are your plans for today, besides running up my phone bill?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I've got nothing. Every day, I always end up having another failed bust attempt blow up in my face. (throws some milk on a cat) Starting today, no busting, no blow up in face. I'm taking a me-day.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll believe it when I see it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (seeing a poster on a wall) Huh, I've never seen that there before!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Cool, huh? I put that up inspired by my close-encounter.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Close encounter?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes. You have heard of the Danville crop circles?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They've been appearing all over town! Some people say that they've been made by spaceships!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't believe in spaceships!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But, Buford, you've been in a space ship. Several, actually.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm a skeptic!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Gather 'round kids, and I'll tell you a story about the close-encounter. It was a dark night, and I was out for a drive, when my motorcar began to behave strangely. Twas then when a bright green light started shining and I couldn't help but walking towards the light scource.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What happened?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, as it turns out, it was just a tow truck driver I had called. He charged up my battery, and off he went!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, if you never saw a UFO, then why did you keep the poster?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, let's just say that the sightings have been enough evidence of UFOs. (leaves)

Name: Buford
Dialog: His words confuse me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad can be like that. But, nevertheless. I know what we're gonna do today

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ohh... Could you just leave? This is really embarrassing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (as he and the others work) Hi, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no, Candace. You're taking a me day. (changes channel) Back to my stories.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (flies in and gets trapped in a chef's hat)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, look at you in your "widdle" trap! So, why the chef's hat, you ask? Well, it was the cheapest way I could find to trap you. Hey, times are tough waiting for my monthly alimony check!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You have to watch every penny. And that's why the 37 minutes, or it's free deal at the local pizzarea is sure to be put to the test.

Name: Pizza man
Dialog: (knocking)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (whilst slowly gliding his feet along the door, constantly checking his watch while doing so) Just a second!

Name: Pizza man
Dialog: (continues knocking)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Any minute!

Name: Pizza man
Dialog: (continues knocking)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (continues gliding feet) Almost there!

Name: Pizza man
Dialog: (knocks)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (opens door)

Name: Pizza man
Dialog: (holds out hand, in a fashion of asking for money)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Can you belive he made me pay, anyway?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It was there when I decided to get revenge. Cheap revenge. I placed explosives in his pizza dough.

Name: But you know what? He turned it into a special! And he actually charged more for it! But then, I decided that I'm not gonna stand for it! (removes lab coat sleeves) Behold
Dialog: the Dough-Blow-Inator! You wear it! (lab coat falls off) You see, this device will blow pizza dough into the air and hold it aloft indefinitely! I'm going to challenge the pizza man to a dough-spinning contest and humiliate him in front of tens of people! And why are you coming with me, you ask? (puts hat on) Well, this just completes the look.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In order to crack this case, we need to get a bird's-eye view of the situation.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, why not use a hot-air balloon, or a helicopter?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I like to stay on theme.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, good idea.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So, Buford, here we are literally inside of a UFO. Do you still not believe in them?

Name: Buford
Dialog: My skepticism has evolved he and shaped my character.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's fan out and start searching for clues.

Name: Farmer
Dialog: (takes picture of UFO with cell phone) Huh, I'm not crazy after all! (to "Bob") Oh, yeah? Well, no one asked you, Farm Utensil Bob!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's a lot of crop circles around here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So you say.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Look, more crop circles! And they are exactly the same shape as the others!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe they're trying to tell us something.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That they like that shape, apparently!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe... We'll have to search for more clues.

Name: Citizens
Dialog: What is that?! Oh, my gosh! It's an invasion!

Name: Man
Dialog: There is nothing that can keep us apart...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Candace.

Name: Woman
Dialog: As long as you love me...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy.

Name: Woman
Dialog: ...we'll never be separated again.

Name: Oshinomi
Dialog: We interrupt this program with some breaking news. A UFO as been spotted in Danville. I'm here with Gordon Gutsofanemu.

Name: Gordon Gutsofanemu
Dialog: These crop circle sightings have been popping up all over Danville, yet none are as important as the UFO just spotted today. Can you describe the creatures flying the ship?

Name: Random guy
Dialog: There were these 2 creatures! One of them had this crazy triangle head and the other looked like a sideways "T"!

Name: Gutsofanemu
Dialog: Sounds terrifying!

Name: Random guy
Dialog: Oh, it was! They don't look human at all!

Name: Gutsofanemu
Dialog: No. No, they don't. Who are these invaders? What are they doing here? What is the meaning of these crop circles? Why can't I time my barbecue right? (in background) Either I'm waiting an hour when they're supposed to heat up, or they're already past their peak when I bring out the steaks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I gotta call Mom! They're gonna be so... Oh, no, they don't! I'm taking a me day!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: (Italian accent) Hey, everybody, she got-a free pizza? (audience cheers) Hey, look-a what you see! It's a dough-osaur! Ha hey! The Leaning Tower of Pizza! Ay? Everyone having a good time?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! No, we're not! We're having a rotten time, you stingy jerk!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: Why you-a callin' me these bad guy things?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Because you cheated me! 37 minutes or free! That was the deal! And 38 minutes later, you welched on it!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: But I would-a never! Wait-a one second! You are the guy who set up-a the traps to slow me down, yes?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, I have traps, but th-they weren't necessarily for you, y'know, specifically, but... Look, enough of your excuses! I challenge you to a dough duel!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: (using his dough as a grass skirt while doing the hula) A dough duel, eh? I accept-a your challenge! If you win, I give you-a free pizza for life! But if I win, you no order my pizza ever again!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Deal! I don't want your stupid pizza anyway. (Perry struggles to get out of the trap.) Don't bother! Chin strap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, this is the last one.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But we still don't know what it means.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe we need to get a fresh take on this. (to Baljeet) Bring up the crop circle map.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not see anything.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Exactly! Because there's nothing to see! Right...there! That's the one spot where the aliens haven't been! I'll bet that's their next stop. Let's go!

Name: Gutsofanemu
Dialog: (on TV) The alien ship has been seen hovering over...

Name: Spokeswoman
Dialog: (on TV) ...makeup tips, (Candace smiles) so you can look your best for the impending alien invasion.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on phone) Candace, didja see the news? That is your brothers, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, but I'm not busting them.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on phone) Uh, hello? The ultimate bust just falls in your lap and you're not gonna jump at the chance? What's up with that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Listen, Stacy!! Me day! No bust, no blow up in face!! FACE!!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on phone) Well, now that you've put it crazy...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Back to my stories. (hangs up) Takin' a me day.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (to Buford) So, if you do not believe the flying saucer is real, why did you want to take a turn flying it?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Just confirmin' it's not real. Besides, I categorically deny I'm flyin' it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look out!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: A little early to be knockin' my pizza down. We haven't even-a started yet!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That wasn't me. You... W-Wait, where's my chef's hat?

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: You-a ready, fella?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nope. First, I'm gonna do a little pre-gloating. I'm goin' to wipe the floor with you. I'm goin' to make you scream for mercy and there will be none! Men will weep. Children will wail! Whales will wail! Like...like this... (Mimics whale song.) Like they do, except they'll be doing it on your behalf! And women will look away as you walk the hall of shame! (beat) Okay, now I'm ready.

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: One-a, two-a, three-a...GO!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no, no!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: (also getting sucked in) Hey! What's-a your deal?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is not at all what I had in mind! Oh! Oh, this really sucks! I mean, literally! Okay!

Name: Man
Dialog: This is really uncomfortable.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Boy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That failure was spectacular...even for me!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: You must be a lot of fun at the parties! (American accent) But, seriously, don't order my pizzas again, okay?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, deal. Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) Well, this is the spot.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fan out, gang. Maybe we can find out why this is the only field in Danville with no crop circles.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You're wastin' your time. There's nothin' here but grass. Grass and this...key! (He uses the key as a hair scratcher.) Ah. Oh, that's good.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's the same shape as the crop circles.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And I suppose that makes it special?

Name: Alien
Dialog: Thank you for returning our key. We left large signs in fields all over the Tri-State Area, but you are the only Earthlings that came to our aid.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no problem. Glad we could help.

Name: Alien
Dialog: To return the favor, here is something you lost in 1977.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! The Voyager Space Probe!

Name: Alien
Dialog: Goodbye and good luck!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So long!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Take it easy! Wow, that artist rendering on the news was really accurate!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, there might be somethin' to this whole UFO thing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I got the pizza you ordered.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I have time to do nice things when I'm not distracted by panicked phone calls.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, look! It's the boys in their UFO! And Mom is in the next room! (beat as Candace's eye twitches again) Nope! I've had a lovely day and I'm not gonna ruin it with another failed bust attempt. No way this day is gonna blow up in my— (She opens the box and the pizza explodes in her face and blocks the saucer from view.) Oh! So that's what they meant by "exploding pizza".

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's all the rage with the foodies. Oh, there's Phineas and Ferb. Hi, boys! (She waves and the gang waves back.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yup, still there. (goes back to bed) I'm not sayin' a word.
